FN-D1JZHN-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 292
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/25/2023
House Bill 292 as introduced would decrease ad valorem tax receipts to the State General Fund,
Public School Fund, Veteran's Assistance Fund, and county and municipal funds by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of state or local ad valorem tax otherwise
assessed on aircraft that is both (1) over 30 years old, and (2) owned by any person who is 65
years of age or older, which would be exempted by this bill.
According to the Department of Revenue, approximately $9.6 million in total ad valorem taxes
was assessed in 2021 for 2,180 aircraft, regardless of age of aircraft or owner.

FN-D1JZHN-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 292
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/26/2023
House Bill 292 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would
decrease ad valorem tax receipts to the State General Fund, Public School Fund, Veteran's
Assistance Fund, and county and municipal funds beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of state or local ad valorem tax otherwise
assessed on certain civil aircraft that is both (1) over 30 years old, and (2) owned by any person
who is 65 years of age or older, which would be exempted by this bill.
According to the Department of Revenue, approximately $9.6 million in total ad valorem taxes
was assessed in 2021 for 2,180 aircraft, regardless of age of aircraft or owner.
